results.remarks: This charming residence was built in 1937 and features classic details like hardwood flooring, multi-pane wood frame windows and smooth plaster walls. The inviting front porch, where the current owners have on countless occasions sat to chat with neighbors, is a good example of the lifestyle this property affords. The living room showcases gorgeous 1930’s craftsmanship like the hand floated coved ceiling and decorative wood burning fireplace both complimented by the warmth of the hardwood floors. The main home features three spacious bedrooms, a beautifully updated hall bath as well as a stylish powder room. The kitchen features natural granite countertops accented by a stone backsplash and stainless steel appliances. The fourth room is a detached, standalone bonus structure offering incredible flexibility. It was originally designed as a premium home office but could also make a great studio space or home gym.  The rear grounds have been transformed into a tranquil garden sanctuary following a recent landscape renovation, offering multiple seating areas to unwind amidst mature trees and vibrant flowering shrubs. Beyond its historic character, the property features a suite of major modern upgrades: a brand-new roof, a newer HVAC system, copper plumbing, an upgraded electrical panel complete with an EV charging station, and a whole-house fan to maximize seasonal cooling efficiency.  Finally, this property is located in the Wood Streets Neighborhood Conservation Area. Long known for its 1920’s Period Revival style homes and dense canopy of mature trees, this neighborhood has been a celebrated staple of the Riverside housing stock for over a century. This home is truly an idyllic retreat and yet is just two miles to the vibrant core of Downtown Riverside and only one mile to the beautiful Bonaminio Park and historic trails of Mount Rubidoux.

results.remarks:
Welcome to this well-maintained single-story home located in Riverside’s Palm Heights Historic District. Situated on a spacious corner lot at Brockton Avenue and Beatty Drive, this property features large windows that provide wide street views and abundant natural light. Interior highlights include hardwood flooring throughout, fresh paint, smooth ceilings, and updated recessed lighting. Architectural details include crown molding, ceiling fans, and a vintage fireplace.
The functional floor plan offers a formal dining area and a breakfast nook. All three bedrooms include walk-in closets, and the primary bedroom features its own separate air-conditioning system. Additional features include a basement for extra storage and a detached two-car garage with built-in cabinetry that may offer potential for conversion to a guest house; buyer to verify.
Outdoor amenities include a spacious front lawn, an additional grass area along the right side of the home, and a recently updated rear patio with fresh wood, a new gate, and red brick. The fully fenced yard and mature landscaping provide multiple areas for outdoor use.
As part of the Palm Heights Historic District, this 1927 home may be eligible for historic-property tax benefits through the Mills Act; buyer to verify with the City of Riverside. The location offers convenient access to Riverside Plaza, Downtown Riverside, and the Mission Inn.

Perched atop the hills in one of Riverside’s most sought-after gated communities, this beautiful turnkey condo is ready for its next owner! Nestled within a pristine and well-maintained neighborhood, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and breathtaking views. Centrally located near some of Riverside’s most popular destinations including Canyon Crest Country Club, University of California, Riverside, Riverside City College, California Baptist University, Mission Inn Hotel & Spa, Downtown Riverside, endless shopping near the Canyon Crest Towne Center, dining, and with easy access to the 60, 215, and 91 freeways all less than a mile away.

One of the few condos in the community with its own full private driveway, with parking for 4 - this home truly stands out! As you step inside, you are greeted by soaring vaulted ceilings that create an open and airy atmosphere. The thoughtfully designed floorplan features a full bedroom and full bathroom downstairs, ideal for multigenerational living or added guest convenience, along with an additional downstairs half bath for guests. The upgraded oversized kitchen opens seamlessly to the dining and living areas, making it perfect for entertaining and everyday living. A stunning spiral staircase leads upstairs to two additional bedrooms, including the spacious primary suite. Both levels of the home feature private balconies where you can relax and take in grand panoramic mountain and hillside views.
This highly desirable community offers residents access to a sparkling pool, spa, and clubhouse. The HOA provides exceptional value by maintaining all front landscaping, insuring the exterior of the homes, and even covering the water bill. To top it all off, this property has NO MELLO-ROOS and an exceptionally low tax rate, making it an even more incredible opportunity to own in one of Riverside’s most sought-after communities!

Step into timeless charm with this beautifully restored 1912 Craftsman located in the highly sought-after Wood Streets neighborhood. Thoughtfully renovated from top to bottom in 2011 while preserving its original character and architectural beauty, this historic home offers the perfect blend of classic craftsmanship and modern convenience.

Featuring 1,662 square feet, this home offers 3 spacious bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and sits on an oversized lot with plenty of room to create your dream backyard, including space for a pool, spa, outdoor entertaining, or future expansion.

The extensive 2011 renovation included a new foundation, framing, electrical, plumbing, insulation, HVAC system, tankless water heater, 40-year roof, kitchen cabinetry, granite countertops, tile flooring, hardwood floors, and stainless steel appliances—providing peace of mind while maintaining the home's historic appeal.

Outside, you'll find a detached two-car garage with newer garage doors and a generously sized backyard rarely found in this desirable neighborhood.

If you've been searching for a move-in ready historic home with modern upgrades in one of Riverside's most iconic neighborhoods, this is the one. Don't miss your opportunity to own a true Wood Streets gem!

The attractive stone-accented exterior creates excellent curb appeal, while the front entry is thoughtfully tucked beside mature landscaping and a covered porch, providing an added sense of privacy.

Step inside to a dramatic high-ceiling living room filled with natural light, creating an open and inviting atmosphere. The modern kitchen features upgraded quartz countertops, abundant cabinetry, and generous storage space, making it ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The adjacent family room offers a cozy fireplace, perfect for relaxing evenings at home. Elegant tile flooring extends throughout the entire first floor.

This spacious home offers 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, including a convenient downstairs bedroom and full bath, ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or a home office. Upstairs features wooden laminate flooring throughout and three additional bedrooms. The expansive primary suite is a true retreat, highlighted by a double-sided fireplace shared between the bedroom and luxurious bathroom, allowing you to enjoy the warmth and ambiance while soaking in the tub. The primary bath also features dual sinks with a vanity area, a separate shower and soaking tub, and a walk-in closet.

The oversized backyard showcases breathtaking canyon views and endless possibilities for outdoor living, entertaining, gardening, or future enhancements. With no rear neighbors, the property enjoys exceptional privacy and a peaceful natural setting.

Conveniently located near UCR, shopping centers, restaurants, and major freeways including the 215, 91, and 60, this home offers outstanding accessibility. Whether you're seeking a primary residence or an investment opportunity with strong rental potential for students, this Canyon Crest gem is a must-see.

Call today before it's gone!

results.remarks: Timeless early-1900s cottage charm meets modern luxury in the heart of historic Downtown Riverside. Built in 1909 with classic hipped-roof character and thoughtfully reimagined for 21st-century living, this completely updated pool home preserves its original details — including rich oak floors and a decorative fireplace — while delivering every contemporary comfort. The spacious living room flows into a formal dining room, and the remodeled kitchen shines with abundant cabinetry, a farmhouse sink, quartz countertops, and updated appliances. Both baths have been tastefully renovated, and the private primary suite sits secluded on its own wing with a rare en-suite bath. Out back, an entertainer's dream awaits: a brand-new pebble saltwater pool with spa, waterfall, fire features, and an adjacent firepit — one of the only downtown homes on the market with a pool — plus a full outdoor kitchen with high-end Lion appliances and granite bar top. Major systems are all updated: newer roof, PEX plumbing, updated electrical (knob-and-tube removed), central A/C and heat, vinyl fencing, and a solar-powered LiftMaster gate for alley-accessible parking. Minutes to Downtown Riverside and the 91/60 freeways. As a 1909 historic home, the property may also qualify for substantial Mills Act property-tax savings — buyer to verify with the City of Riverside. A true one-of-a-kind.
